title: 외국법자문사법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Avoidance/Evasion)
(1) Any person to whom a disciplinary action has been requested by the Ministry of Justice Disciplinary Committee pursuant to Article 42 of the Act may, if there is a reason that makes it impossible to expect a fair decision from the members of the Ministry of Justice Disciplinary Committee (including substitute members, as referred to in this Article, Article 10, Article 13, and Article 14), make a written explanation and request to be excused.
(2) When a request to be excused is made pursuant to Article 1, the decision of the Ministry of Justice Disciplinary Committee determines whether the member in question should be excused. In this case, the member who received the request to be excused shall not participate in the decision.
(3) Members of the Ministry of Justice Disciplinary Committee may avoid deliberation on the matter if it falls under Article 1 of this Article or Article 98(3) of the "Legal Practitioners Act" as applied in Article 44(3) of the Act.
